ventures.name: Hearth & Ladle
ventures.description: Fresh meals, quick service and a welcoming place to stop.
ventures.tip: Perishable meals; lunchtime crowds reward fast preparation.
ventures.need: Workers need quick, affordable lunches; evening visitors want treats.
ventures.tradeoff: Hot meals need reliable preparation and short queues. Coffee and doughnuts require different machines.

ventures.name: Copperwick Works
ventures.description: Make useful things, restore worn equipment and keep promises.
ventures.tip: Longer jobs; craftsmanship raises willingness to pay.
ventures.need: Merchants need repairs and dependable furniture for their premises.
ventures.tradeoff: Complex jobs need skilled preparation and the right parts; expensive machines need enough work.

ventures.name: Thread & Thistle
ventures.description: Everyday garments and well-made travelling clothes.
ventures.tip: Style campaigns and thoughtful displays attract collectors.
ventures.need: Residents need work clothes; travellers look for durable garments and bags.
ventures.tradeoff: Durable stock lasts, but slow production and an unpopular range can tie up cash.

ventures.name: Silverfin Exchange
ventures.description: Cool, carefully handled catches for tables across town.
ventures.tip: Cold storage protects stock; freshness and delivery matter.
ventures.need: Families and kitchens want fresh fish, with some demand for preserved catch.
ventures.tradeoff: Freshness and cold storage matter. Preserved products need processing equipment and a different supply plan.

ventures.name: Bramble & Bloom
ventures.description: Seasonal produce, herbs and gathered ingredients.
ventures.tip: Affordable baskets; seasonal events change customer demand.
ventures.need: Households want seasonal produce, herbs, flowers and garden plants.
ventures.tradeoff: Perishable produce must sell quickly. Processing and potted products offer different shelf lives.

ventures.name: Deepwell Foundry
ventures.description: Sort materials, finish metalwork and supply other makers.
ventures.tip: Capital-intensive preparation and durable wholesale orders.
ventures.need: Local makers need fittings, refined materials and finished stone.
ventures.tradeoff: Heavy equipment has a high acquisition cost. Slow finishing can bottleneck otherwise valuable products.

ventures.name: Wayfarer General
ventures.description: Select a useful range and help travellers find what they need.
ventures.tip: Fast handling; merchandising and reliable stock drive sales.
ventures.need: Travellers want useful essentials; residents also buy household goods and gifts.
ventures.tradeoff: Choose a range customers want. A wide menu needs more materials and can trap money in unsold stock.

ventures.name: Parcel & Post
ventures.description: Move parcels safely and choose which delivery promises to make.
ventures.tip: Service jobs; route choice balances speed, cost and reliability.
ventures.need: Residents and merchants need parcels delivered reliably and safely.
ventures.tradeoff: Express, chilled and fragile deliveries need different equipment and packaging; route choices affect capacity.

ventures.name: Lantern & Ladder
ventures.description: Rent useful equipment, maintain it and help customers choose.
ventures.tip: Bonus venture: asset investment, maintenance and utilization.
ventures.need: Visitors and merchants need temporary access to tools, ladders and camping equipment.
ventures.tradeoff: Equipment on hire cannot serve another customer until it returns. Maintenance and fleet variety matter.

ventures.name: Shear & Shine
ventures.description: Appointments, clean stations and a finish worth returning for.
ventures.tip: Chairs, skilled stylists and reception must work together; long colour appointments occupy capacity.
ventures.need: Guests need haircuts, washes and styling they can book reliably.
ventures.tradeoff: Chairs, skilled stylists and reception must work together; long colour appointments occupy capacity.

ventures.name: Paws & Play
ventures.description: Safe play, quiet rest and individual care for visiting dogs.
ventures.tip: Resting capacity and care staff limit admissions. Extra pens alone do not create demand or good care.
ventures.need: Dog owners need reliable care while they work or explore town.
ventures.tradeoff: Resting capacity and care staff limit admissions. Extra pens alone do not create demand or good care.

ventures.name: Lantern Links
ventures.description: A little putting course with clever obstacles and a relaxed welcome.
ventures.tip: Rounds occupy lane capacity. Clubs, course maintenance and promotion must match visitor demand.
ventures.need: Families and visitors want affordable activities and short waits.
ventures.tradeoff: Rounds occupy lane capacity. Clubs, course maintenance and promotion must match visitor demand.

ventures.name: Sugar & Starlight
ventures.description: Fresh-baked treats, cool desserts and a tempting counter.
ventures.tip: Baking, frozen products and displays need different machines. Overproduction can spoil expensive ingredients.
ventures.need: Visitors want treats and residents need desserts for small occasions.
ventures.tradeoff: Baking, frozen products and displays need different machines. Overproduction can spoil expensive ingredients.

ventures.name: Kettle & Pearl
ventures.description: A straightforward drinks counter that can grow into a bubble-tea stop.
ventures.tip: Start with two simple drinks; milk and bubble tea add cold storage, materials and equipment costs.
ventures.need: Workers and travellers want quick drinks at an accessible price.
ventures.tradeoff: Start with two simple drinks; milk and bubble tea add cold storage, materials and equipment costs.

ventures.name: Eastcourt Empty Premises
ventures.description: No inherited stock or equipment. Choose a business model and build your own operation.
ventures.tip: Perishable meals; lunchtime crowds reward fast preparation.
ventures.need: You will need to identify a customer need and choose a business model.
ventures.tradeoff: No inherited equipment or stock. A larger opening cash budget must cover everything you install and order.

staff.name: Sable

staff.name: Pip

staff.name: Ada
staff.bio: Measured decisions and very dependable routines.
